name: product-card
title: Product card
description: A production product card for React and Next.js: image with hover zoom, sale and stock badges, compare-at price, colour swatches with radiogroup semantics, add to cart, and a matching skeleton.
docs: Pass a plain product object and handle onAddToCart; the card never fetches. Format prices before you pass them so the card stays locale-neutral. Use renderImage to plug in next/image.
